description: Machine-readable classification of the `jsonrpc` TCK bucket into the five stable sub-categories named in a2a-nexus#1500. pytestNodeIdSelectors are deterministic, mutually exclusive node IDs from the pinned official TCK. The measured values come from the fresh complete run anchored below; a category can only be promoted once it remains green across the stability window (see docs/a2a-tck-runbook.md).

derivedFrom: official A2A TCK verbose PASSED/FAILED/SKIPPED node outcomes
provenance.limits: The values cover only the five deterministic selector sets, not full conformance. Unknown node IDs remain explicitly unclassified in tck-history.json. Version negotiation, artifact/message projection, and error-codes/ErrorInfo are promoted (error-codes with one capability-unreachable selector documented in capabilityExcludedSelectors). Task-not-found and streaming remain non-gating. Two requirement-runner tests (CORE-SEND-003, CORE-MULTI-002a) are unwinnable by construction at the pinned TCK ref: their requirement definitions lack expected_error bindings so the runner demands response.success for error-path tests.

subCategories.issueCategory: 1. 표준 A2A JSON-RPC error code와 ErrorInfo.domain
subCategories.codeEvidence: packages/broker/src/a2a/json-rpc.ts: A2A reserved family bound (-32001 TASK_NOT_FOUND, -32002 TASK_NOT_CANCELABLE), google.rpc.ErrorInfo with domain a2a-protocol.org in error.data
subCategories.note: Promoted after independent official-TCK workflow runs 30225853781 and 30225919582 both measured 12 passed / 0 failed / 1 capability-skip; the PR gate runs the 12 runnable selectors (the capability-unreachable selector is documented in capabilityExcludedSelectors).

capabilityExcludedSelectors.reason: Capability-unreachable by design: the TCK skips this test whenever the agent card declares capabilities.streaming=true (its only -32004 trigger is SendStreamingMessage on a non-streaming agent). The broker declares streaming and the TCK requires it for the streaming suite, so no broker change can make this selector run. Same skip class as the push-notification selectors.

architecturalBlockers.note: The TCK single-agent client cannot pre-register a broker worker, so SendMessage-gated CORE task-creating tests fail/skip. Recorded in docs/a2a-tck-runbook.md as an architectural decision for follow-up, NOT an error-code correctness gap. This cascade inflates the jsonrpc failing count independent of the five sub-categories above.
